propositions: Three 300s wall-clock git fetch callsites lack throughput-based stall detection and retry logic, exposing them to full timeout waits on byte-starved transfers
The stall_abort_args() seam from fix 12e4 is reusable across network fetch sites without snapshot-specific state
A zero-byte remote must abort as a stall within ~10s, while a continuously-dribbling remote above the throughput floor must not trigger abort
The arming must be scoped to fetch subcommands only, as local config/worktree calls and ls-remote probes do not benefit from curl transport tuning
